value.body: A two-year M.Sc (Ag) in a specialisation such as agronomy, plant breeding and genetics, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics or extension. It is taught at state and central agricultural universities and ICAR institutes, and includes a research thesis.

items.label: PG enrolment in agriculture
items.note: All PG years, as reported to AISHE
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, PG enrolment by subject, based on actual responses (Ministry of Education)

items.label: Out-of-state scholarship
items.note: ICAR National Talent Scholarship (PG), for studying outside your home state

value.title: How you get in
value.body: B.Sc (Ag) or a related four-year degree with the minimum marks ICAR or the university sets. ICAR's AIEEA-PG, conducted by NTA, fills seats in ICAR institutes and a share of seats in agricultural universities; the remaining seats go through state university entrance tests.

value.title: At a glance
items: It leads to research (Ph.D., ICAR scientist recruitment), state agriculture officer posts, bank agricultural officer posts, and agri-input and agribusiness companies.
Fellowships depend on the admission route and the state.
University teaching posts usually need NET and a Ph.D.
